homeAbout.heading: About PubHoliday
homeAbout.p1: PubHoliday is a free, fast public-holiday calendar covering countries across every region. Whether you are planning time off, scheduling shipments, or simply checking what is closed this week, you can look up official public holidays, observances, and long weekends in seconds.
homeAbout.p2: Pick a country from the list above to see its full holiday calendar for the current and next year. We highlight long weekends so you can make the most of bridging days, and our world clock keeps you in sync with local time anywhere.
homeAbout.li1: Up-to-date official public holidays for {count} countries and regions.
homeAbout.li2: Long-weekend detection to help you plan extended breaks.
homeAbout.li3: Current-time world clock alongside each country's calendar.
homeAbout.li4: Subscribe to Pro for saved countries, personal holiday lists, and ICS exports.

forTeams.metaTitle: Holiday calendar for distributed teams — PubHoliday
forTeams.metaDescription: Keep your distributed team in sync across {count} countries and {langs} languages. See who is off, plan shared time off, and subscribe to team calendars.
forTeams.heroTitle: A holiday calendar built for teams that span the globe
forTeams.heroLead: When your team sits across time zones and countries, one shared calendar of who is off — and why — keeps work fair. PubHoliday gives you that from a single, annually refreshed dataset.
forTeams.coverageCardBody: Holiday dates for {count} countries — from the markets where your colleagues actually live, not a handful of defaults.
forTeams.valueHeading: One calendar for every country you work in
forTeams.valueSubtitle: Everything here is built from the same dataset, refreshed every year — so your team always compares like for like.
forTeams.valueCoverageTitle: Every market your team works in
forTeams.valueCoverageBody: Holiday dates for {count} countries, covering the markets where your colleagues actually live — not a handful of popular defaults.
forTeams.valueLanguagesBody: Localized into {langs} languages. Holiday names appear in their local form where available, so nothing gets lost in a translation your team never asked for.
forTeams.valueCalendarTitle: Calendars your team can actually use
forTeams.valueCalendarBody: Subscribe to any country calendar as an iCal feed and drop it straight into the tools your team already uses. No export, no reformatting.
forTeams.useHeading: How teams put it to work
forTeams.use1Body: Know when your colleagues in São Paulo or Seoul are actually offline, so deadlines and reviews never land on someone's holiday.
forTeams.use2Body: Plan payroll, launches, and support rosters around real public holidays in each market — not a rough guess.
forTeams.use3Body: Spot the weeks when the whole team gets a natural break, and plan shared time off before the calendar fills up.
forTeams.faqSubtitle: Straight answers about how PubHoliday works for a team.
forTeams.faq1Q: Can my whole team use PubHoliday?
forTeams.faq1A: Yes. Each member can use their own account, and Pro unlocks multi-year data, a multi-country watchlist, and an ad-free experience. There is no separate team plan yet — start with a Pro account and subscribe to the country calendars your team needs.
forTeams.faq2Q: Do you offer an API for our internal tools?
forTeams.faq2A: The data behind PubHoliday comes from the open Nager.Date dataset, which exposes a public API you can call from your own tools. Our pages and calendar feeds stay in sync with the same annually refreshed data.
forTeams.faq3A: Billing runs through our payment partner and supports card payments today. If you need an invoice for a company purchase, email us from the address in the footer and we will help.
forTeams.faq4Q: Are holidays shown in our team's languages?
forTeams.faq4A: The site is localized into {langs} languages — English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, and Arabic. Where a holiday has a local name, we show it alongside the English one.
forTeams.faq5Q: How current is the holiday data?
forTeams.faq5A: We refresh the dataset every year and publish dates for the current and upcoming years. Public holidays can change at short notice, so always confirm critical dates with official sources before planning.
forTeams.ctaTitle: Give your team a calendar it can rely on
forTeams.ctaBody: Explore {count} countries of holiday data in your language — and if it fits, take Pro for multi-year and multi-country features.
